documents.title: Rheological modulation and microstructural densification of hydrogels induced by Choy sum polysaccharides: Dual applications in dysphagia diets and anthocyanin stabilization.
meta: He, Liming; Li, Junjie; Liu, Enhui; Zhou, Hong; Zhu, Hongfei; Xia, Yanshi; Yong, Yueyuan; Li, Xiaopeng
documents.summary: 研究菜心多糖调控明胶水凝胶的流变学与微观结构，用于吞咽障碍饮食和花青素稳定，完全不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或AI/物理模拟方法。
documents.body: Texture-modified foods facilitate dysphagia care and nutrient supplementation, yet conventional high-molecular-weight polysaccharide-gelatin hydrogels suffer phase separation, sticky texture and aspiration risks. Herein, cold-set composite hydrogels of gelatin and low-molecular-weight Guangdong Choy sum polysaccharides (GCSP, Mw = 71.49 kDa), were constructed to tune swallowing-friendly rheology and stabilize anthocyanin. DLS and FTIR characterizations corroborated strong hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions between GCSP and gelatin, forming micron aggregates. SEM observations validated the microstructural densification. GCSP reduced porosity from 78.5% (neat gelatin) to 36.2%, building a dense, thick-walled interpenetrating network. The compact network slowed anthocyanin photodegradation, retaining over 40% after 10-day UV exposure. Moreover, GCSP lowered hardness (250.3-142.5 g) alongside springiness, while preserving high cohesiveness ( approximately 0.85) and desirable thixotropic recovery, mitigating brittleness and excessive stickiness. Swallowing simulations complied with IDDSI Level 4/5 standards. This work elucidates polysaccharide-regulated protein rearrangement, offering a dual-functional matrix for safe elderly dysphagia food with anthocyanin photoprotection. 质构改良食品有助于吞咽障碍护理和营养补充，然而传统的高分子量多糖-明胶水凝胶存在相分离 (phase separation)、粘稠质地及误吸风险。本文构建了明胶与低分子量广东菜心多糖 (GCSP, Mw = 71.49 kDa) 的冷凝固复合水凝胶，以调控适宜吞咽的流变学特性并稳定花青素。动态光散射 (DLS) 和傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 表征证实了GCSP与明胶之间存在强氢键和静电相互作用，形成微米级聚集体。扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 观察验证了微观结构的致密化。GCSP将孔隙率从78.5%（纯明胶）降低至36.2%，构建了致密厚壁的互穿网络。该致密网络减缓了花青素的光降解，在10天紫外线暴露后仍保留超过40%。此外，GCSP降低了硬度（250.3-142.5 g）和弹性，同时保持了高内聚性（约0.85）和理想的触变恢复性，减轻了脆性和过度粘性。吞咽模拟符合IDDSI 4/5级标准。本研究阐明了多糖调控的蛋白质重排，为具有花青素光保护功能的老年安全吞咽障碍食品提供了双功能基质。

documents.title: Extended Reality Interventions for Osteoarthritis of the Knee and Recovery After Total Knee Arthroplasty: Systematic Review and Meta-Analyses.
meta: Kalinowski, Caleb; Goldsmith, Elizabeth; Anthony, Maylen; Landsteiner, Adrienne; Ullman, Kristen; Zerzan, Nicholas; Rich, Tonya; Calvert, Collin; Wilt, Timothy J; Duan-Porter, Wei; Ewart, David
documents.summary: 该文是关于扩展现实干预对膝骨关节炎和全膝关节置换术后康复的系统综述与荟萃分析，完全不涉及无序蛋白、蛋白互作或AI/物理模拟方法。
documents.body: BACKGROUND: Nonpharmacologic interventions are important for treating knee pain due to osteoarthritis or after total knee arthroplasty (TKA), and extended reality (XR) technology may enhance treatments for these indications. OBJECTIVE: This systematic review aimed to evaluate XR interventions for pain due to knee osteoarthritis (KOA) or for recovery after TKA. METHODS: Databases were searched through May 2023 and updated in December 2025. Eligible trials evaluated XR interventions to treat KOA pain or after TKA. We classified interventions by depth of immersion and clinical mechanism. We used the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) criteria to determine the certainty of evidence for prioritized outcomes. Meta-analyses were performed when >/=3 studies evaluated similar comparisons, outcomes, and time points. RESULTS: Eligible trials addressed KOA (k=12) or recovery after TKA (k=9). Sample sizes ranged from 36 to 306 participants, and most studies had a follow-up of </=3 months. Nineteen studies assessed pain-related functioning and pain intensity, and 5 assessed adverse events (AEs). For KOA, 10 studies examined interactive digital rehabilitation (IDR), and 2 examined virtual reality (VR)-digitally augmented exercise (DAE). IDR for KOA may result in better pain-related functioning (low certainty of evidence [COE]; pooled standardized mean difference [SMD] -0.59, 95% CI -1.11 to -0.06; prediction interval [PI] -1.72 to 0.55; k=5) and lower pain intensity at 6-8 weeks (low COE; pooled SMD -0.46, 95% CI -0.92 to 0.00; PI -1.39 to 0.47; k=4). VR-DAE for KOA (k=2) produced inconsistent results (very low COE). For post-TKA studies, 5 examined IDR, 2 examined VR-DAE, 1 examined VR-distraction, and 1 examined VR-psychoeducation. Post-TKA IDR may result in better pain-related functioning (low [k=4] and moderate COE [k=1]) but little to no difference in pain intensity (low-moderate COE; pooled SMD at 3-4 months -0.12, 95% CI -0.75 to 0.52; PI -1.63 to 1.27; k=3). VR-psychoeducation probably results in lower pain at 4 weeks (moderate COE; k=1), and VR-distraction may result in 6 months (low COE; k=1), whereas VR-DAE produced mixed findings (k=2; very low COE). IDR was not associated with AEs, and VR may not be associated with AEs for KOA (high and low COE), though AE reporting was uncommon (k=5) and evidence was very uncertain for post-TKA. CONCLUSIONS: IDR may augment treatment for KOA and post-TKA recovery, and VR may benefit post-TKA rehabilitation. This review is the first to stratify by level of immersion, clinical mechanism, and follow-up duration and to systematically evaluate AEs. IDR may be ready for integration into KOA care, while use after TKA needs more evidence. Randomized controlled trials with implementation outcomes could determine how XR interventions can be used for KOA, whereas trials evaluating efficacy and AEs are needed before their use for post-TKA. 背景：非药物干预对于治疗膝骨关节炎或全膝关节置换术（TKA）后的膝关节疼痛至关重要，而扩展现实（XR）技术可能增强针对这些适应症的治疗。目的：本系统综述旨在评估XR干预措施对膝骨关节炎（KOA）疼痛或TKA术后恢复的效果。方法：检索数据库至2023年5月，并于2025年12月更新。符合条件的试验评估了用于治疗KOA疼痛或TKA术后的XR干预措施。我们根据沉浸深度和临床机制对干预措施进行分类。使用推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（GRADE）标准确定优先结局的证据确定性。当≥3项研究评估了相似的比较、结局和时间点时，进行荟萃分析。结果：符合条件的试验涉及KOA（k=12）或TKA术后恢复（k=9）。样本量范围为36至306名参与者，大多数研究的随访时间≤3个月。19项研究评估了疼痛相关功能和疼痛强度，5项评估了不良事件（AEs）。对于KOA，10项研究考察了交互式数字康复（IDR），2项考察了虚拟现实（VR）-数字增强运动（DAE）。IDR用于KOA可能在6-8周时改善疼痛相关功能（低证据确定性[COE]；合并标准化均数差[SMD] -0.59，95% CI -1.11至-0.06；预测区间[PI] -1.72至0.55；k=5）并降低疼痛强度（低COE；合并SMD -0.46，95% CI -0.92至0.00；PI -1.39至0.47；k=4）。VR-DAE用于KOA（k=2）结果不一致（极低COE）。对于TKA术后研究，5项考察了IDR，2项考察了VR-DAE，1项考察了VR-分心，1项考察了VR-心理教育。TKA术后IDR可能改善疼痛相关功能（低[k=4]和中度COE [k=1]），但对疼痛强度影响很小或无差异（低-中度COE；3-4个月时合并SMD -0.12，95% CI -0.75至0.52；PI -1.63至1.27；k=3）。VR-心理教育可能在4周时降低疼痛（中度COE；k=1），VR-分心可能在6个月时降低疼痛（低COE；k=1），而VR-DAE结果混杂（k=2；极低COE）。IDR与AEs无关，VR可能与KOA的AEs无关（高和低COE），尽管AEs报告不常见（k=5），且TKA术后的证据非常不确定。结论：IDR可能增强KOA和TKA术后恢复的治疗，VR可能有益于TKA术后康复。本综述首次按沉浸水平、临床机制和随访持续时间进行分层，并系统评估AEs。IDR可能已准备好整合到KOA护理中，而TKA术后使用需要更多证据。具有实施结局的随机对照试验可确定XR干预措施如何用于KOA，而在用于TKA术后之前，需要评估疗效和AEs的试验。

documents.title: Membrane Phase, Charge, and Curvature Regulate alpha-Synuclein Binding Dynamics.
meta: Kou, Orianna H; Sakurai, Cailyn M; Ramirez, Stephanie Y; Kim, Brian H; Johnson, David H; Zhang, Zixin; Lee, Christopher T; Zeno, Wade F
Langmuir : the ACS journal of surfaces and colloids
documents.summary: 该文结合实验与粗粒化分子动力学模拟，系统研究了膜相、电荷和曲率如何协同调控α-突触核蛋白（一种无序蛋白）与脂质膜的结合动力学与稳定性，揭示了无序蛋白-膜互作的热力学与动力学机制。
documents.body: alpha-Synuclein (alphaSyn) is an intrinsically disordered protein whose interactions with lipid membranes are central to both its physiological function and its role in synucleopathies. While membrane charge, phase, and curvature are each known to influence alphaSyn binding, these properties are typically examined independently, leaving their combined effects on both equilibrium and dynamic membrane association unresolved. Here, we systematically investigate how membrane phase and charge jointly regulate alphaSyn binding, curvature sensitivity, and exchange dynamics using fluorescence microscopy, circular dichroism spectroscopy, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP), complemented by coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. Under zwitterionic conditions, alphaSyn preferentially binds highly curved gel-phase membranes, driven by curvature-dependent enrichment of packing defects arising from faceted vesicle morphologies. Incorporation of anionic lipids selectively enhances binding in liquid-phase membranes while attenuating curvature-dependent partitioning in gel-phase membranes. Dynamic measurements reveal that membrane phase and charge also govern the stability of membrane-associated alphaSyn, with gel-phase membranes and anionic lipids promoting kinetically stabilized states. Simulations show that curvature-induced defect formation is strongly amplified in gel-phase membranes but largely insensitive to charge. These findings establish that alphaSyn-membrane interactions are governed by a cooperative interplay between membrane phase, curvature, and charge and highlight the importance of resolving both thermodynamic and kinetic contributions to protein-membrane binding. α-突触核蛋白（alpha-Synuclein, alphaSyn）是一种 intrinsically disordered protein，其与脂质膜的相互作用对其生理功能和突触核蛋白病中的作用均至关重要。尽管已知膜电荷、相态和曲率各自影响alphaSyn结合，但这些特性通常被独立研究，导致它们对平衡态和动态膜关联的综合效应尚未明确。本文中，我们利用荧光显微镜、圆二色光谱和荧光漂白恢复（fluorescence recovery after photobleaching, FRAP），并结合粗粒化分子动力学（coarse-grained molecular dynamics）模拟，系统研究了膜相态和电荷如何共同调控alphaSyn结合、曲率敏感性和交换动力学。在 zwitterionic 条件下，alphaSyn优先结合高曲率的 gel-phase 膜，这由曲率依赖的堆积缺陷富集驱动，而堆积缺陷源于多面体囊泡形态。阴离子脂质的掺入选择性增强 liquid-phase 膜中的结合，同时减弱 gel-phase 膜中曲率依赖的分配。动态测量表明，膜相态和电荷也调控膜结合alphaSyn的稳定性，其中 gel-phase 膜和阴离子脂质促进动力学稳定状态。模拟显示，曲率诱导的缺陷形成在 gel-phase 膜中显著放大，但对电荷基本不敏感。这些发现确立了alphaSyn-膜相互作用受膜相态、曲率和电荷之间的协同调控，并强调了解析蛋白质-膜结合的热力学和动力学贡献的重要性。 01 基本信息 标题 ：Membrane Phase, Charge, and Curvature Regulate alpha-Synuclein Binding Dynamics 作者与单位 ：Kou, Orianna H; 方法」方向中的位置 ：本文聚焦于无序蛋白alpha-Synuclein与生物膜的物理化学相互作用，属于实验与模拟结合的传统生物物理研究，不涉及AI方法或相分离。在「无序蛋白 × 蛋白互作」方向中，它系统研究了膜物理性质（相、电荷、曲率）对蛋白结合平衡与动力学的协同调控，填补了以往独立研究各因素的空白。 02 一句话总结 本文通过荧光显微镜、圆二色光谱、FRAP和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，系统揭示了膜相（凝胶相 vs. 液相）、电荷（阴离子脂质）和曲率如何协同调控alpha-Synuclein的结合偏好、曲率敏感性和交换动力学，发现凝胶相膜通过曲率依赖的堆积缺陷富集结合，而阴离子脂质在液相膜中增强结合但削弱凝胶相中的曲率依赖性。 03 研究问题 具体问题 ：膜相（凝胶相 vs. 液相）、膜电荷（阴离子脂质）和膜曲率如何共同调控alpha-Synuclein的结合平衡、曲率敏感性和动态交换行为？ 为什么重要 ：alpha-Synuclein与膜的相互作用是其生理功能（如突触囊泡调控）和病理聚集（如帕金森病）的核心，但以往研究孤立考察各因素，缺乏对协同效应的理解。 现有方法为何不足 ：现有研究通常单独改变膜电荷、相或曲率，未系统探究三者联合作用对结合动力学（如FRAP恢复速率）的影响，且缺乏对凝胶相膜中曲率依赖机制的分子层面解释。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 ：Can membrane phase, charge, and curvature cooperatively regulate the equilibrium binding, curvature sensitivity, and exchange dynamics of alpha-Synuclein? 04 背景与发展脉络 脉络来源 ：仅本文框架（基于摘要推断，未提供外部文献引用）。 阶段一：独立因素研究 ：早期工作分别考察膜电荷（阴离子脂质促进结合）、膜相（凝胶相 vs. 液相影响插入深度）、膜曲率（高曲率促进结合）。优点：建立基础认知。局限：忽略协同效应。 阶段二：组合因素探索 ：少数研究开始组合两个因素（如电荷+曲率），但未系统覆盖三相（相、电荷、曲率）的联合作用，且缺乏动力学测量。 本文主张的位置 ：本文首次系统联合调控膜相、电荷和曲率，同时测量平衡结合（荧光显微镜）和动力学（FRAP），并结合模拟揭示凝胶相膜中曲率依赖的堆积缺陷机制，提出膜物理性质协同调控alphaSyn结合的观点。 05 核心痛点 痛点 表现 成因或作者解释 文中证据 膜相、电荷、曲率对alphaSyn结合的协同效应未知 以往研究独立考察各因素，无法预测联合作用下的结合行为 实验设计复杂，需同时控制多个膜参数；缺乏系统性的多因素实验方案 摘要指出“these properties are typically examined independently” 凝胶相膜中曲率依赖结合的分子机制不清 凝胶相膜中alphaSyn偏好高曲率，但原因不明 作者提出凝胶相膜在高曲率下形成“faceted vesicle morphologies”，产生堆积缺陷，促进结合 模拟显示“curvature-induced defect formation is strongly amplified in gel-phase membranes” 膜结合动力学（交换速率）的调控因素不明确 以往多关注平衡结合，忽略动态稳定性 膜相和电荷可能影响结合态的稳定性，但缺乏系统动力学测量 FRAP实验揭示“membrane phase and charge also govern the stability of membrane-associated alphaSyn” 06 核心思想 表面方法 ：通过荧光显微镜测量alphaSyn与不同相（凝胶/液相）、电荷（中性/阴离子）、曲率（不同尺寸囊泡）的膜结合量；通过FRAP测量结合后的交换动力学；通过圆二色光谱监测蛋白构象；通过粗粒化MD模拟解释分子机制。 核心洞察 ：膜相、电荷和曲率并非独立作用，而是协同调控alphaSyn结合。凝胶相膜通过曲率诱导的堆积缺陷富集结合，而阴离子脂质在液相膜中增强结合但削弱凝胶相中的曲率依赖性。动力学上，凝胶相和阴离子脂质共同促进“kinetically stabilized states”（动力学稳定态），即结合后交换缓慢。 可能的普适教训 ：[Analysis] 对于与膜相互作用的无序蛋白，其结合行为不能由单一膜性质预测，必须考虑膜物理状态的协同效应。动力学测量（如FRAP）比平衡结合更能揭示结合态的稳定性，这对理解蛋白在膜上的功能（如信号传导）和病理（如聚集）至关重要。 07 方法总览 输入 ：不同组成（DOPC/DPPC/阴离子脂质）、不同尺寸（曲率）的脂质体；重组alpha-Synuclein蛋白。 输出 ：alphaSyn与膜的结合量（荧光强度）、结合动力学（FRAP恢复曲线）、蛋白二级结构（CD光谱）、模拟中的堆积缺陷分布和结合自由能。 模块 ： 1. 膜制备与表征 ：制备不同相（凝胶相DPPC、液相DOPC）、不同电荷（添加阴离子脂质）、不同曲率（挤出不同孔径）的脂质体。 2. 结合实验 ：荧光标记alphaSyn，与脂质体孵育后，通过荧光显微镜或离心结合实验测量结合量。 3. 动力学实验 ：FRAP测量膜上alphaSyn的荧光恢复速率，反映交换动力学。 4. 构象分析 ：圆二色光谱检测alphaSyn在膜结合前后的二级结构变化。 5. 分子动力学模拟 ：粗粒化MD模拟不同相、曲率、电荷的膜，计算堆积缺陷密度和alphaSyn结合倾向。 训练 ：不适用（无机器学习）。 工具 ：荧光显微镜、FRAP、圆二色光谱仪、粗粒化MD模拟（如Martini力场）。 反馈回路 ：实验观察（如结合偏好）指导模拟参数设定；模拟结果（如缺陷机制）解释实验现象。 假设 ：alphaSyn结合主要受膜物理性质（堆积缺陷、静电）驱动，而非特定脂质受体；FRAP恢复反映蛋白在膜上的解离/交换速率。 文字流程 ：先制备不同相、电荷、曲率的脂质体 → 加入荧光标记alphaSyn → 用荧光显微镜测量平衡结合量 → 用FRAP测量结合动力学 → 用CD光谱检查构象 → documents.title: Biomolecular Condensates Dictate the Folding Landscape of Protein Alpha-Helices.
meta: Journal of the American Chemical Society
documents.summary: 利用原子模拟和贝叶斯优化研究生物分子凝聚体如何通过多价相互作用与拥挤效应重塑蛋白质α-螺旋的折叠景观，揭示了无序蛋白/IDR介导的PPI与相分离对折叠动力学的耦合机制。
documents.body: Protein structure is exquisitely sensitive to the surrounding chemical environment, and many proteins encounter complex environments within cells. Importantly, numerous proteins organize into biomolecular condensates horizontal line dense macromolecular assemblies with distinct physicochemical properties. This raises a fundamental question: how do condensates reshape protein structure and dynamics? Here, we investigate how protein folding landscapes are altered inside condensates, using the protein alpha-helix as a model folded domain. Atomistic simulations suggest the helix-coil transition within condensates differs markedly from its behavior in dilute solution or in the presence of inert crowders. We then use Bayesian optimization to develop a chemically specific, residue-resolution model for quantification of alpha-helical folding and apply it to characterize diverse helices, including alpha-helical domains from the disease-associated proteins TDP-43, Annexin A11, and Androgen Receptor, within condensates of varying physicochemical properties. Our results support a framework in which multivalent interactions drive unfolding while crowding promotes folding, and alpha-helix conformational ensembles inside condensates emerge from this balance. Additionally, we show that helix folding transitions are kinetically frustrated inside condensates because they are coupled to the time scale of contact rearrangement with co-condensate proteins. As such, alpha-helix folding landscapes within condensates are dually sequence-dependent, informed by both the sequence of the alpha-helical domain and co-condensate proteins. Together, our work has implications for understanding condensate-mediated proteinopathies, targeting aberrant condensates, and designing condensates to program protein function across scales. 蛋白质结构对周围化学环境极为敏感，许多蛋白质在细胞内会遭遇复杂环境。重要的是，大量蛋白质会组织成生物分子凝聚体 (biomolecular condensates)——即具有独特物理化学性质的致密大分子组装体。这引出一个基本问题：凝聚体如何重塑蛋白质的结构与动力学？在此，我们以蛋白质α-螺旋 (alpha-helix) 作为折叠结构域模型，研究凝聚体内部蛋白质折叠景观如何改变。原子模拟 Reviewer 1 Overall assessment The abstract presents an intriguing and potentially important hypothesis about how biomolecular condensates modulate protein folding. The conceptual framework—balancing multivalent interaction-driven unfolding with crowding-driven folding—is novel and could have broad implications. However, the abstract lacks the quantitative evidence, methodological detail, and validation necessary to assess the strength of the claims. The conclusions are stated as if established, but the supporting data are not visible. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in biophysics, protein folding, phase separation, and cell biology. The work could interest those studying condensate-mediated proteinopathies (e.g., ALS, cancer) and those designing synthetic condensates for protein function control. The dual sequence-dependence concept is particularly relevant for understanding how mutations in both the folded domain and co-condensate proteins might alter disease risk. Major strengths 1. The central question—how condensates reshape protein structure—is timely and important. 2. The proposed balance between multivalent interactions (unfolding) and crowding (folding) is a physically plausible and testable framework. 3. The application to disease-associated proteins (TDP-43, Annexin A11, Androgen Receptor) suggests potential translational relevance. 4. The concept of kinetic frustration due to coupling with condensate dynamics is a novel and interesting extension. documents.title: Reconstitution of multistep recruitment of ULK1 to membranes in autophagy.
meta: Duan, Yongjia; Lu, Ye; Paul, Sanjoy; Betz, Johannes; Wilhelm, Lea P; Cook, Annan S I; Ren, Xuefeng; Adriaenssens, Elias; Martens, Sascha; Ganley, Ian G; Hummer, Gerhard; Hurley, James H
documents.summary: 该文通过生化重建、分子动力学模拟和细胞实验，揭示了ULK1无序区域中的PVP基序与ATG13:ATG101 HORMA二聚体互作，协同WIPI蛋白将ULK1激酶结构域招募至自噬体膜的多步骤机制，核心关注无序蛋白介导的PPI及膜结合机制建模。
documents.body: The human Unc51-like kinase 1 (ULK1) autophagy-initiating complex consists of ULK1, FIP200, and the Hop/Rev7/Mad2 (HORMA) domain heterodimer ATG13:ATG101. Phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) is essential to recruit ULK1 complex (ULK1C) to membranes for ULK1, but ULK1C subunits do not contain PI3P-binding domains. Here, we show that the ATG13:ATG101 dimer forms a complex with the PI3P-binding protein WD40 interacting with phosphoinositide protein 3 (WIPI3), as well as WIPI2. Bound to WIPI2 and WIPI3, ATG13:ATG101 inserts its Trp-Phe (WF) finger into the membrane. Molecular dynamics simulations show that WIPIs and the WF finger cooperatively stabilize the complex on membranes. Biochemical reconstitution and cell-based assays show that WIPI3:ATG13 engagement promotes ATG16L1 phosphorylation, autophagy, and mitophagy. A kinase domain (KD)-proximal Pro-Val-Pro (PVP) motif in the ULK1 intrinsically disordered region docks onto the ATG13:ATG101 HORMA dimer brings the ULK1 KD close to the membrane. The PVP motif is essential for in vitro ULK1 phosphorylation of ATG16L1 and important for autophagy and mitophagy. These data establish a stepwise pathway for recruitment of the ULK1 KD to the vicinity of the membrane surface. 本文利用AlphaFold2预测蛋白复合物结构，结合分子动力学模拟和生化重建，揭示了ULK1复合物通过无序区（IDR）中的短线性基序（PVP motif）与ATG13 HORMA结构域互作，从而将ULK1激酶结构域锚定在膜附近。这属于利用AI方法（AlphaFold2）解析无序蛋白介导的蛋白互作在膜招募中的机制。 02 一句话总结 本文通过生化重建、细胞实验和分子动力学模拟，揭示了ULK1复合物通过WIPI3/2与ATG13:ATG101的互作以及ATG101的WF finger插入膜，实现PI3P依赖的膜招募，并进一步通过ULK1 IDR中的PVP基序与ATG13 HORMA结构域结合，将ULK1激酶结构域定位到膜附近以磷酸化底物。 03 研究问题 具体问题 : PI3P如何招募不含PI3P结合结构域的ULK1复合物（ULK1C）到自噬体膜上？ULK1的激酶结构域（KD）如何接近其膜结合底物？ 为什么重要 : ULK1C的膜招募是自噬启动的核心事件，其机制长期未知。理解该过程对于阐明自噬调控机制和相关疾病（如帕金森病）至关重要。 现有方法为何不足 : 先前研究认为ATG13的碱性残基簇直接结合PI3P，但晶体结构不支持该结论，且更严格的GUV结合实验无法重复。ULK1的KD与膜之间隔着约650个残基的无序区，其如何接近膜底物也不清楚。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 : Can the ATG13:ATG101 HORMA dimer, through interactions with WIPI proteins and its own membrane-binding motifs, and a subsequent interaction between the ULK1 IDR and the ATG13 HORMA domain, explain the PI3P-dependent recruitment and membrane-proximal positioning of the ULK1 kinase? 04 背景与发展脉络 阶段一: 核心复合物发现与结构解析 (约2010-2020) 代表性方法 : 生化纯化、X射线晶体学、冷冻电镜。 优点 : 确定了ULK1C的组成（ULK1, FIP200, ATG13, ATG101）和核心结构域的组织方式。 局限 : 未能解释ULK1C如何被招募到PI3P阳性的膜上，以及ULK1 KD如何接近膜。 阶段二: PI3P依赖性与直接结合假说 (约2010-2020) 代表性方法 : 点印迹、细胞成像。 优点 : 建立了PI3P对ULK1C招募的重要性。 局限 : 提出的ATG13直接结合PI3P的假说被后续结构生物学和更严格的生化实验否定。 阶段三: WIPI蛋白作为桥梁的发现 (2020-2023) 代表性方法 : 免疫共沉淀、AlphaFold2预测。 优点 : 发现WIPI2在BNIP3/NIX依赖的线粒体自噬中与ATG13互作，为WIPI作为桥梁提供了线索。 局限 : 该机制是否适用于一般性自噬，以及WIPI3的作用尚不清楚。 本文主张的位置 : 本文整合了AlphaFold2预测、MD模拟、体外重建和细胞实验，建立了一个多步骤的ULK1C膜招募模型，阐明了WIPI3/2、ATG101的WF finger和CTH、以及ULK1 IDR中的PVP基序在其中的协同作用，解决了长期存在的核心问题。 注明 : 这条脉络是「经外部核验」的，基于文中引用的文献和领域共识。 05 核心痛点 痛点 表现 成因或作者解释 文中证据 PI3P依赖的ULK1C招募机制不明 ULK1C亚基不含PI3P结合域，但ULK1C招募依赖于PI3P活性。 先前提出的ATG13直接结合PI3P的假说被否定。 引言指出晶体结构无PI3P结合口袋，且GUV结合实验无法重复（Results节）。 ULK1激酶结构域（KD）远离膜 ULK1 KD与膜之间隔着约650个残基的无序区（ULK1 IDR + ATG13 IDR），难以接近膜结合底物。 缺乏将ULK1 KD锚定到膜附近的机制。 引言描述ULK1和ATG13的域结构，指出KD与膜招募单元的距离（Results节）。 ATG101的必需功能未解释 ATG101是自噬必需因子，但其WF finger和CTH的功能未知。 已知WF finger对自噬重要，但不参与ATG9结合。 引言指出ATG101 WF finger功能必需但互作伙伴未知（Results节）。 WIPI3在ULK1C招募中的作用不明确 WIPI3与ULK1C的互作及其在一般性自噬中的作用存在争议。 不同研究对WIPI3在自噬中的必要性结论不一。 讨论部分指出WIPI3 KO在HEK293细胞中无表型，但在其他细胞中重要（Discussion节）。 06 核心思想 表面方法 : 通过AlphaFold2预测、分子动力学模拟、体外脂质体/GUV重建和细胞实验，系统性地解析了ULK1C从被PI3P招募到激酶结构域定位的分子机制。 核心洞察 : ULK1C的膜招募是一个多步骤的协同过程：首先，PI3P通过WIPI3/2蛋白间接招募ATG13:ATG101 HORMA二聚体；其次，ATG101的WF finger和CTH直接插入膜，稳定复合物；最后，ULK1 IDR中的PVP基序与ATG13 HORMA结构域结合，将ULK1 KD拉近到膜表面，使其能够磷酸化膜结合底物。 可能的普适教训 [Analysis]: 对于大型、多结构域的激酶复合物，其催化亚基的膜定位可能不是一步到位的，而是通过多个弱相互作用（如蛋白-脂质、蛋白-蛋白）的协同，逐步将催化结构域“递送”到其作用位点。这种多步骤机制提供了精细的调控节点。 07 方法总览 输入 : 纯化的ULK1C组分（ULK1, FIP200, ATG13, ATG101）、WIPI2/3、底物ATG16L1片段、含PI3P的脂质体。 输出 : Reviewer 1 Overall assessment This is a thorough and well-executed study that addresses a long-standing question in the autophagy field: how the ULK1 complex is recruited to PI3P-containing membranes despite lacking a canonical PI3P-binding domain. The authors present a compelling stepwise model involving WIPI2, WIPI3, the ATG101 WF finger, and a novel ULK1 IDR-ATG13 HORMA interaction. The combination of in vitro reconstitution, cell-based assays, and computational modeling is a strength. However, several concerns regarding the quantitative rigor of the cellular data and the generalizability of the model to all forms of autophagy need to be addressed. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in the fields of autophagy, membrane biology, and kinase signaling. The study provides a mechanistic framework for a central event in autophagy initiation, which has implications for understanding diseases linked to autophagy dysfunction, such as Parkinson's disease and cancer. Major strengths 1. The study elegantly solves a long-standing paradox in the field. 2. The use of a minimal reconstituted system to dissect the stepwise recruitment is powerful. 3. The combination of computational modeling (AlphaFold2 and MD simulations) with experimental validation is robust. 4. The identification of a novel ULK1 IDR-ATG13 HORMA interaction provides a mechanism for kinase positioning. Evidence pointer Figures 4, 6, and S6, S10 Concern The quantification of the autophagy and mitophagy assays (e.g., Halo-LC3 flux, mito-QC) relies on manual or semi-automated image analysis. The statistical power and the number of independent experiments for these key cellular phenotypes are not always clearly stated in the figure legends. For example, in Figure 4K-L, the Halo-LC3 flux assay shows a clear defect for the HF|DD mutant, but the error bars and statistical test are not fully described in the legend. Similarly, the mito-QC data in Figure 6A-B and S6A-B would benefit from a more detailed description of the quantification pipeline and the number of cells analyzed per replicate. Why it matters The cellular validation is critical for establishing the physiological relevance of the proposed mechanism. Without rigorous and transparent quantification, the strength of the in vivo conclusions is weakened. Resolution test Provide a clear statement in the figure legends for all cellular assays (Figures 4, 6, S6, S10) detailing: (1) the number of independent biological replicates (n), (2) the total number of cells analyzed per condition per replicate, (3) the specific statistical test used (e.g., two-way ANOVA with Šidák's multiple-comparison test), and (4) whether the data are presented as mean ± SD or SEM. For the mito-QC and LC3 flux assays, consider providing a more detailed description of the automated or semi-automated quantification pipeline in the Methods section. Concern ID R1-M2 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Generalizability of the model Claim pointer The authors propose a stepwise pathway for ULK1 recruitment that is general to autophagy initiation. Evidence pointer Discussion, Figure 7 Concern The model is built primarily on data from starvation-induced autophagy and DFP-induced mitophagy. The authors acknowledge that WIPI3 KO has been reported to have no effect on starvation-induced autophagy in HEK293 cells (reference 61). While they discuss this discrepancy, they do not provide a clear explanation or experimental data to resolve it. The model's generalizability to other forms of selective autophagy (e.g., xenophagy, aggrephagy) or to different cell types is not addressed. Why it matters A central claim of the paper is that this is a unifying model for ULK1 recruitment. The existence of a contradictory report and the lack of testing in other contexts limits the scope of the claim. Resolution test 1. Discuss the discrepancy with reference 61 in more detail. Is it possible that WIPI3 is redundant with WIPI2 in HEK293 cells, or that the KO was incomplete? 2. Add a sentence or two in the Discussion acknowledging that the model may be context-dependent and that further work is needed to test its generalizability to other cell types and autophagy-inducing conditions. Concern ID R1-M3 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Mechanistic detail of the ULK1 IDR-ATG13 interaction Claim pointer The ULK1 IDR (residues 428-450) binds directly to the ATG13 HORMA domain, and this interaction is critical for kinase positioning and activity. Evidence pointer Figures 5, S7, S8 Concern The evidence for the direct interaction is strong (AlphaFold2, GST pull-down). However, the functional consequence of this interaction is modeled as a reduction in the average distance of the ULK1 KD to the membrane (from 19 to 12 nm). The model is based on a single set of assumptions about the IDR conformation and the position of the palmitoylated cysteines. The authors should discuss the limitations of this model and whether other mechanisms (e.g., allosteric activation of ULK1 by the ATG13 HORMA domain) could also contribute to the observed increase in ATG16L1 phosphorylation. Why it matters The paper's central conclusion is that the IDR-HD interaction positions the kinase. If the primary effect is allosteric, the model would need to be revised. Resolution test 1. In the Discussion, explicitly state that the modeling data are consistent with a proximity-based mechanism but do not rule out additional allosteric effects. 2. documents.title: Retrieval of binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome using protein language model representations
documents.summary: 使用蛋白质语言模型检索AlphaFold人类蛋白质组中的结合位点，但对象为折叠蛋白的配体结合口袋，不涉及无序蛋白或PPI机制。
documents.body: Protein language models (PLMs) provide powerful representations of protein sequence, but their utility for proteome-scale binding-site retrieval remains unclear. Here, we present PocketScope, a training-free framework that represents cavity-lining residues using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings and retrieves related binding sites through exhaustive lateinteraction MaxSim, without pooling or approximate nearest-neighbor search. PocketScope identified 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins in the AlphaFold human proteome and recovered documented drug off-targets across a curated set of pharmacological pairs. On the ProSPECCTs benchmark, PocketScope ranks 1st of 23 methods by mean rank across the ten collections. PocketScope provides a practical framework for proteome-scale off-target prediction. PocketScope is open source and also freely available as a web server at https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope . 蛋白质语言模型 (protein language models, PLMs) 为蛋白质序列提供了强大的表征，但其在蛋白质组规模结合位点检索中的实用性仍不明确。在此，我们提出PocketScope，一个无需训练的框架，该框架使用冻结的ESM-C 600M嵌入来表示空腔衬里残基，并通过穷举的后期交互MaxSim（无需池化或近似最近邻搜索）来检索相关结合位点。PocketScope在AlphaFold人类蛋白质组中识别了37,682个蛋白质上的153,805个空腔，并在一个精选的药理学配对集合中恢复了已记录的药物脱靶靶点。在ProSPECCTs基准测试中，PocketScope在十个集合的平均排名中位列23种方法中的第1名。PocketScope为蛋白质组规模的脱靶预测提供了一个实用框架。PocketScope是开源的，也可作为网络服务器免费访问，网址为https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope。

documents.title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Protein Language Model Embeddings for Drug–Target Affinity Prediction
documents.summary: 该文评估蛋白质语言模型嵌入在药物-靶标亲和力预测中的效果，但对象为折叠蛋白与小分子药物，不涉及无序蛋白/IDR、PPI机制或相分离，与本课题无关。
documents.body: Accurate identification of drug–target interactions is consequential for novel drug discovery and development. Deep learning methods for drug–target affinity (DTA) prediction have shown great promise in accelerating drug discovery and reducing development costs. Although graph neural networks have improved drug representation learning for DTA prediction tasks, many models still struggle to effectively and efficiently capture protein information, limiting overall prediction accuracy. In this work, we systematically evaluate the impact of pre-trained protein language models (PLMs) on the downstream task of predicting binding affinity between drugs and target proteins. We design multiple experiments across four different molecular representation backbones and assess the effect of incorporating PLM embeddings, comparing their performance to classical 1D convolution methods. We evaluate four families of PLMs which we integrate into PLM-GraphDTA, each built on distinct architectures and optimized for different tasks, including structure prediction, function prediction, and sequence unmasking. Additionally, we evaluate DeepGraphDTA, an architectural modification of the baseline convolution method designed to improve protein representation learning. The models are evaluated on two benchmark datasets, Davis and KIBA, using concordance index (CI) and mean squared error (MSE) as performance metrics. We further evaluate the generalization power of each model using cold-start train and test splits, and analyze the per-protein contribution to total CI. The results indicate simple architectural modifications to traditional convolution methods may be sufficient to bridge the gap to large pre-trained PLMs. 准确识别药物-靶点相互作用对于新药发现与开发至关重要。用于药物-靶点亲和力（DTA）预测的深度学习方法在加速药物发现和降低开发成本方面展现出巨大潜力。尽管图神经网络改进了DTA预测任务中的药物表示学习，但许多模型仍难以有效且高效地捕获蛋白质信息，从而限制了整体预测精度。在本工作中，我们系统评估了预训练蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）对预测药物与靶点蛋白结合亲和力这一下游任务的影响。我们设计了跨四种不同分子表示骨干网络的多个实验，评估了整合PLM嵌入的效果，并将其性能与经典的一维卷积方法进行了比较。我们评估了四个PLM家族，并将其整合到PLM-GraphDTA中，这些模型基于不同架构构建，并针对不同任务（包括结构预测、功能预测和序列掩码）进行了优化。此外，我们还评估了DeepGraphDTA，这是对基线卷积方法的一种架构改进，旨在改善蛋白质表示学习。模型在两个基准数据集Davis和KIBA上，使用一致性指数（CI）和均方误差（MSE）作为性能指标进行评估。我们进一步使用冷启动训练和测试划分评估了每个模型的泛化能力，并分析了每个蛋白质对总CI的贡献。结果表明，对传统卷积方法进行简单的架构改进可能足以缩小与大型预训练PLMs之间的差距。

documents.summary: 该文使用计算流体力学优化婴儿经鼻气溶胶给药系统，研究对象为表面活性剂而非无序蛋白，不涉及蛋白-蛋白互作或相分离，与本课题完全无关。
documents.body: PURPOSE: Direct-to-infant (D2I) transnasal aerosol surfactant therapy (AST) offers a promising non-invasive alternative for treating neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (RDS). However, achieving high lung delivery efficiency with dry powder inhalers (DPIs) requires careful optimization of complex fluid-particle interactions. This study used computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to optimize an Infant Air‑Jet Dry Powder Aerosol Delivery System (iDP‑ADS) and derive transferable design principles. METHODS: A CFD model of the iDP‑ADS coupled to a 31‑week preterm nose‑throat geometry was validated against in vitro measurements. Sensitivity analyses evaluated modeling assumptions (steady‑state vs. transient, monodisperse vs. polydisperse) and critical design parameters influencing aerosol delivery, such as upstream air volume, interface geometry, temporal aerosol emission profiles, and actuation flow rates. RESULTS: The CFD model demonstrated strong in vitro agreement (2.8% mean absolute difference). Regarding modeling: standard simplifications, particularly steady-state approximations, overpredicted lung transmission (~24%), establishing the necessity of high-fidelity transient simulations with polydisperse aerosols. Regarding aerosol delivery: integrating an upstream air volume created "hydrodynamic shielding," reducing relative interface losses by up to 50%. A 10 mm diffusive path length and 20 degrees  (inward and downward) prong alignment balanced jet dissipation while minimizing nasal deposition. Front-loading of aerosol emission prevented entrapment of 10-14% of the dose in anatomical dead space. An optimal system-specific actuation flow rate of 3 L/min achieved ~53.5% aerosol lung transmission, balancing aerosolization efficiency against turbulence-driven transport losses. CONCLUSIONS: High-efficiency transnasal AST requires balancing often competing aerosol generation physics, transport behavior, and clinical constraints. This study highlights CFD as a vital design tool, providing key lessons to inform future modeling and practical interface development. 目的：直接对婴儿（D2I）经鼻气溶胶表面活性剂治疗（AST）为新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征（RDS）提供了一种有前景的无创替代方案。然而，使用干粉吸入器（DPIs）实现高肺部递送效率需要仔细优化复杂的流体-颗粒相互作用。本研究采用计算流体动力学（CFD）优化婴儿空气喷射干粉气溶胶递送系统（iDP‑ADS），并推导出可迁移的设计原则。方法：将耦合了31周早产儿鼻-喉几何结构的iDP‑ADS的CFD模型与体外测量结果进行验证。敏感性分析评估了建模假设（稳态与瞬态、单分散与多分散）以及影响气溶胶递送的关键设计参数，例如上游空气体积、接口几何结构、气溶胶时间发射曲线和驱动流速。结果：CFD模型与体外结果高度一致（平均绝对差异2.8%）。关于建模：标准简化方法，特别是稳态近似，高估了肺部传输率（约24%），从而确立了采用多分散气溶胶进行高保真瞬态模拟的必要性。关于气溶胶递送：整合上游空气体积产生了“流体动力学屏蔽”，将相对接口损失降低了高达50%。10 mm扩散路径长度和20度（向内和向下）的叉头对齐在平衡射流耗散的同时最小化了鼻腔沉积。气溶胶发射的前端加载防止了10-14%的剂量滞留在解剖死腔中。系统特定的最佳驱动流速为3 L/min，实现了约53.5%的气溶胶肺部传输率，平衡了气溶胶化效率与湍流驱动的传输损失。结论：高效经鼻AST需要平衡通常相互竞争的气溶胶生成物理机制、传输行为及临床约束。本研究强调了CFD作为关键设计工具的作用，为未来建模和实际接口开发提供了重要经验。
